title: All Factions In The Lobby
description: Every seat, person or bot, has the same faction picker over the 24 base-game and Prophecy of Kings factions the rule bot has plans for. The host can set any seat; a person sets their own. Held factions are greyed with the holder's name, the server refuses duplicates (409) and unknown factions (400), and everyone sees all choices. The create dialog now opens on four players. Synthetic: the real lobby components against a mocked server answering like the real one, regenerated by npm run screenshots -- CZ.

shots.heading: Create dialog: 4 players
shots.caption: The first dialog opens on four players; the other options are unchanged.

shots.heading: Full faction picker
shots.caption: Random plus 24 factions, grouped Base game / Prophecy of Kings, each with a two-letter sigil and printed name. The list scrolls; Sol is this seat's choice, Hacan is greyed because a bot holds it.

shots.heading: Search
shots.caption: Typing filters by name or id (here 'na': Naalu, Naaz, Nekro, Nomad...).

shots.heading: A person chooses their own faction
shots.caption: Blair (not the host) has a picker on her own seat only; Sol (Alex) and Titans (Casey) were greyed with their holders' names. She picked Mahact.

shots.heading: Host chooses for another person: open
shots.caption: The host's picker on Blair's seat. Titans is Casey's, Sol his own, Nomad a bot's.

shots.heading: Host chose Yssaril for Blair
shots.caption: Everyone in the lobby sees the choice in the seat list.

shots.heading: Duplicate refused
shots.caption: Casey took Nekro a moment ago in another tab. The server answers 409 and the lobby shows its reason; nothing changed.

shots.heading: Phone: full picker
shots.caption: Stays inside the screen, scrolls inside the list, options at least 40 px tall (asserted).

shots.heading: Phone: search
shots.caption: The search box filters the 24 entries.

shots.heading: Phone: person chooses own
shots.caption: Own seat only; held factions greyed with the holder.

shots.heading: Phone: host picks for another person
shots.caption: Open list on another person's seat.

shots.heading: Phone: host picked
shots.caption: The seat list shows the choice.
